text_block_list.text:
In the morning, Oguri Cap
walked straight past the school gates.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That was close.
I appreciate it, Trainer... *yawn*."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I had trouble falling asleep last night, so I was counting takoyaki instead of sheep.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Next, she counted taiyaki,
counted carrots, counted hamburger steaks...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, morning had come.
Even after that, Oguri Cap still had sleepy eyes.
